ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65% high-intensity white/cream pixels concentrated in the central lobes and 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels localized at the margins and peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous white fields occupying the central 70% of each lobe. These are bordered by thick, irregular black margins. Significant black mottling and radial striations emerge from the central base. Yellowish-brown (high-chroma) patches are overlaid on the white fields, primarily in the upper-median regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A wide, shallow U-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 145 degrees; depth is minimal relative to the vertical height of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. The right lobe distal margin exhibits high-amplitude, jagged 'sawtooth' peaks, while the left lobe shows more rounded, low-amplitude wave-like irregularities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning to sharp, upward-sweeping convex tips at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density, dark, irregular clusters (likely barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Scattered dark circular micro-spots are visible within the white field of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, horizontal dark linear mark is visible on the upper-left white field. Multiple vertical, thin, parallel dark lines (rake marks) are detected on the right lobe, extending from the trailing edge into the white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue topography and dark encrustations at the tips of both lobes, suggesting significant chronic scarring or parasitic load. Several distinct V-shaped indentations along the trailing edge margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-orange biological staining/diatom film covering approximately 40% of the visible white ventral surface area.
